title: MemorySubjectsEnsureRequest
description: Idempotent get-or-create of a subject. Sole idempotency_key exemption: get-or-create is naturally idempotent and its outcome is recoverable via memory.subjects.get (§7.0.5). kind is set only on creation; a mismatch on an existing subject is not an error. Grant: capture or admin. Mutating op without idempotency_key: the sole §7.0.5 exemption — get-or-create is naturally idempotent and recoverable via memory.subjects.get. The response is a MemoryReceipt.

ns.description: Namespace key in ExtensionMap key form.

kind.description: Optional namespaced kind metadata, set only on creation. Never a closed enum; never authorization input.
